profile.headline: Consulting Web Developder at Vape Nation
profile.summary: Goal Oriented, Self Starter and Hard Worker.

positions.title: Consulting Web Developer
positions.description: Everything from helping build the site to engaging in social media.

positions.title: Assistant
positions.description: I help with day to day operations such as press releases, updating paperwork, working at street fairs, taking pictures of events, and anything else that is needed. I am constantly getting new jobs from fixing canopies to creating Facebook events. There is always something to do, wither it is filing paperwork to updating our excel sheets. I also work at the street fairs, festivals and flea markets doing morning prep and taking pictures throughout the day. I answer phones when I am in the office and take reservations for street fairs when needed.

positions.title: Part Owner/Operator
positions.description:
Antique jewelry business specializing in gold, silver, and semi-precious stones for sale to private collectors, dealers and general public. Providing customers with exceptional service and detailed product information based on the global market conditions. Including background on older pieces where the information would be pertinent. Knowledgeable in the verification and proper maintenance of precious metals.

Visit us here: http://www.rubylane.com/shop/markettreasures

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: I run the Facebook Fan Page at JC Promotions Inc. This is a great opportunity for both me and the company I work for. I will gain much needed social media marketing skills and JC Promotions will get a Facebook page that truly represents their company in a great light. I make events and invite all 1000+ friends that they have on Facebook, making sure every market, show or event they do is properly advertised.

positions.title: Freelance/PT Studio Assistant
positions.description: Assistant to the Studio Manager.  Responsible for numerous day-to-day jobs to ensure the smooth operation of the studio and client service.  Maintained cleanliness of studio facilities, set up daily café and assisted with catering, worked closely with studio manager to equip photo and digital video shoots, pull and place lighting and grip equipment while providing clients with prompt and courteous service.

positions.title: Graduate Seeking Entry Position of Growth
positions.description: Started my own business and run its social media marketing.
